parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the coffee machine is made of durable plastic and covers the filter basket area.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping and keeps the coffee grounds enclosed during brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be opened or closed by lifting or rotating, allowing access to the filter compartment.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container, or carafe, is a glass vessel that holds the brewed coffee.
parts.Functional_description: It collects the brewed coffee from the drip mechanism and allows pouring through its handle and spout.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted and placed back onto the base; it is detachable for serving and cleaning.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural component of the coffee machine, made of heat-resistant plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the heating element, water reservoir, and control buttons, providing stability and functionality.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, supporting the other components and containing internal mechanisms.
